Mobile City Light Mask Set (CSS media-query swap)

nodes.label: #motion-trigger Start Button
nodes.rationale: Hidden by default; shown so the user taps to grant DeviceOrientation permission (required by iOS Safari) to enable tilt parallax.

nodes.label: data-z_index Depth Attribute
nodes.rationale: Each layer declares a depth number; higher values move more under parallax, creating layered 3D depth.

nodes.label: Storm Cloud Layers (far/deep/middle/midband/lower/near)
nodes.rationale: Six cloud sections interleaved with three lightning layers so flashes appear behind/between/in front of clouds, each with its own data-z_index for parallax depth.

nodes.label: Inline Bootstrap Script
nodes.rationale: Uses 150 stars on screens <=900px vs 300 on desktop to keep mobile performant.

nodes.label: Pixel / Painting Texture Overlay Idea
nodes.rationale: Considered overlay to give the whole scene a pixel-art or painted look; not implemented.

nodes.label: City Light Mask Layer (4096x2048 alpha masks tinted via CSS mask-image, screen blend)
nodes.norm_label: city light mask layer (4096x2048 alpha masks tinted via css mask-image, screen blend)

nodes.label: Common Street Lantern Light Mask (dotted row of lantern points)
nodes.norm_label: common street lantern light mask (dotted row of lantern points)

nodes.label: Mobile Architecture Light Mask
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 transparent alpha mask of lit windows on larger civic/temple-like architecture (cluster of vertical window slits right of center); half-res of desktop mask, swapped in via styles.css mobile media query on .city-light--architecture

nodes.label: Mobile Home Lights Mask 1
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 alpha mask of scattered small house-window light pixels along the Jerusalem skyline band; mobile half-res of desktop home-1

nodes.label: Mobile Home Lights Mask 2
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 alpha mask of scattered house-window lights (alternate set) on the city band; mobile half-res of desktop home-2

nodes.label: Mobile Home Lights Mask 3
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 alpha mask of scattered house-window lights (alternate set); mobile half-res of desktop home-3

nodes.label: Mobile Home Lights Mask 4
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 alpha mask of scattered house-window lights (alternate set); mobile half-res of desktop home-4

nodes.label: Mobile Home Lights Mask 5
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 alpha mask of scattered house-window lights (alternate set); mobile half-res of desktop home-5

nodes.label: Mobile Common Lantern Mask
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 alpha mask of a dense row of small street-lantern dots across the city band; mobile half-res of desktop lantern-common

nodes.label: Mobile Variant Lantern Mask
nodes.rationale: 2048x1024 alpha mask of a sparser row of lantern dots; mobile half-res of desktop lantern-variant

nodes.label: Christ Wind Crucifixion Animation (GIF, 57 frames @120ms)
nodes.rationale: Transparent-background animated crucifix of Jesus (crown of thorns, loincloth stirring in wind, INRI titulus in Hebrew/Greek/Latin) used as the central foreground figure of the parallax scene.

nodes.label: Bug: Zooming Breaks Mobile (done)
nodes.rationale: Fixed by adding `html, body { touch-action: none; }` to styles.css
